scope: Fixed-memory analytic nonlinear-remainder budget checks on the original joint chart; no new nonlinear fits, chart replacement, cold start or MCU qualification
preregistration: Commit this plan before the four retained-trace comparisons. Commit tested implementation before creating a receipt. Preserve failures and all earlier results; do not tune budget, radii or acceptance thresholds from new results.

representation.reference: Unchanged bounded_event_001 augmented QR and retained-history C estimator
representation.coordinates: Original initial-state joint theta/alpha chart, existing 16 coordinate scales and radii
representation.curvature: 19 structurally possible scaled Hessian entries: 9 RC, 7 hysteresis, 3 SOC/capacity
representation.online_statistic: C_ij = hypot(C_ij, sup_box(abs(scaled Hessian_ij))/sigma) for each observation
representation.state: Interval RC and hysteresis states, derivative envelopes, actual elapsed time and signed/unsigned charge; never reset at event seals
representation.claim: Real-arithmetic Taylor and triangle/Cauchy inequalities give norm(nonlin-minus-affine prediction / sigma)<=E and abs(L_nonlinear-L_affine)<=B on the fixed box
representation.arithmetic: Ordinary C double and libm evaluation without outward rounding; arithmetic_validated=false. Falsification checks are numerical evidence, not a formal floating-point certificate.
representation.model: Existing smooth illustrative OCV only; derivative bounds abs(Uprime)<=1.79 and abs(Usecond)<=4. Measured PWL OCV is rejected as unsupported.
representation.enclosure_domain: Entire original rectangular chart, even infeasible parts, using the global smooth OCV extension. Candidate physical supports, coupled entering hysteresis and complete historical SOC endpoint path are checked separately.
representation.noise: Same known common iid 1mV voltage-noise likelihood as the frozen reference
representation.evidence_integrity: Matched immutable source/chart/count/time/charge and atomic paired ingestion; history and active-event factors contribute once each; no posterior prior and no fresh budget origin after substeps

budget.rationale: Engineering comparison budget equal to 5% of the existing DeltaNLL=2 local profile screen; not a probability or coverage statement
budget.analytic_budget_pass: Inside declared chart and physical support, finite bound B<=0.1
budget.eligible_update: Analytic budget pass AND zero flagged anchor-residual events AND L_affine+B<L_anchor
budget.zero_step: Can pass the error budget but is never counted as a descent update
budget.failure_semantics: Over-budget means the sufficient bound does not qualify the candidate. It does not establish that the actual candidate is inaccurate. Outside-chart means unavailable, not likelihood exclusion.
budget.known_conservatism: Existing quiet-tail full-step exact remainder norm alone implies a Cauchy bound about0.441NLL, despite observed signed error about-0.00005062NLL. This method cannot qualify that full step to0.1, even with a perfect remainder-norm bound.

acquisition.chronology: Use each actual dt, current and sample index in original order; voltage at interval end; positive current discharges
acquisition.event_policy: Unchanged current/dt boundary or256 samples; sealing the likelihood factor does not reset the remainder state

candidate_policy.full_step: Existing minimum-norm affine step with relative eigen cutoff1e-10; report discarded/null directions without assigning zero uncertainty
candidate_policy.scaled_full_steps: Full step divided by2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256; every displacement measured from the same original chart anchor
candidate_policy.conditional_SOC_Q: Solve the2x2 SOC/logQ normal-equation block while holding the other14 candidate displacements at0. This is a conditional trial update, not a claim that nuisance parameters are known. Retain the full16D evidence and uncertainty.
candidate_policy.affine_sublevel_probes: Eight deterministic trigonometric directions in the retained eigenspace, mapped to DeltaNLL=2 around the affine minimum. Rank-deficient cases explore only the retained space; null directions remain unresolved and physically supported.
candidate_policy.unexcited_control: Gamma-minus-only displacement equal to half its configured radius; before negative throughput its curvature is0 while its parameter remains unexcited
candidate_policy.no_clipping: Report out-of-domain candidates and exclude them from analytic-budget claims; do not silently project them or change the chart

region_check.set: Intersection of original coordinate box and physical support with L_affine<=L_affine_min+2
region_check.uniform_prediction_bound: E_box obtained by substituting all configured radii in the nonnegative sparse remainder polynomial
region_check.interpretation: Sufficient bound conditional on set membership, including physical extents along null directions. Does not assert the set is nonempty, that every box point is low-loss, or that points outside the box are excluded by evidence.
region_check.budget: Report pass/fail at the same0.1NLL budget without retuning. Uniform failure is a substantive limitation of this design.

checks.tolerance_meaning: Numerical audit allowance only; not added to the online0.1 budget or presented as a floating-point proof
checks.zero_and_alpha_only: Exact analytic E=B=0; audit uses the model's exact affine alpha form consistently for all candidates
checks.unexcited: 400s gamma-minus curvature remains0, rank/null status is preserved, Q/SOC precision remains unresolved
checks.known_bad_inside_point: Existing inside_SOC_Q point at2100s must fail0.1NLL budget despite passing radius; its replay error remains exposed
checks.nominal_chart: Flagged residuals prevent eligible updates; do not relabel local rank or narrow ranges as cold-start success
checks.matched_state: Wrong source/order/nonfinite ingestion and mismatched chart/count query fail; paired banks are atomic
checks.domain: PWL OCV unsupported; candidate radius is not a likelihood certificate; no chart-change API
checks.unit_scope: Exercise current signs, zero dt, actual-dt variation, event partition, all19 structural pairs and alpha-only linearity
checks.truth: No synthetic truth in inference, chart, bounds, budget or candidate generation; any truth scoring occurs after inference
checks.audit: Reopen observations only in the separately named host validation pass; online objects retain no raw observations

account_for: new remainder bank including config and audit fields
memory.lifetime: Core state and scratch independent of observation/event count; no unaccounted full-bank atomic copy
memory.target: Approximately10KiB eventual subsystem goal is not met by assumption; no Cortex-M23 claim

outputs.receipt: Hash plan, implementation, binary, configs, observations and retained reference; refuse overwrite
outputs.frozen_policy: Do not edit B001 numerical implementation, receipts or original35Hz results; no60-fit or profile campaign reruns

next_decision: If full-region or useful joint-step validity remains unqualified, record that result and identify the next bounded statistic or carried-state contract needed. A bound on the old polynomial does not reconstruct a new historical Jacobian or exact nonlinear carried state.
